ety.text: Borrowed from Late Latin basaltes, a misspelling of Latin basanites, from Ancient Greek βασανίτης (basanítēs), from βάσανος (básanos, “touchstone”).

ety.text: Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic Владимѣръ (Vladiměrŭ), from Proto-Slavic *Voldiměrъ (where further etymology is listed). By surface analysis, влад(еть) (vlad(etʹ), “to master, to possess”) + мир (mir, “peace”), with the second component changed by folk etymology from Old Church Slavonic мѣръ (měrŭ, “great”).
